recommendation.summary: 值得参与，建议先完成低成本任务，再决定是否追加投入。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Open the Nowa Farming Page
guide.description: Go to the Nowa Farming page . Access is invite-only at this stage, so have a code ready before you start. The public code is NOWA.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet
guide.description: Click Connect Wallet and pick your wallet. Nowa supports MetaMask, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Phantom, Keplr, Solflare, and Typhon. Sign the connection request when prompted.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Enter Your Invite Code
guide.description: Type NOWA into the invite field. Once accepted, you land on the Nowa Farming dashboard showing your balances, badge tier, and leaderboard rank.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Three Mandatory Tasks
guide.description: Farming stays locked until all three are done: Follow Nowa on X and join the Telegram community Invite at least one friend using your personal invite code Click Request Funds to claim your free Devnet-value tokens The Request Funds drop includes NUSC, NOWA, ETH, BTC, BNB, TRX, USDC, USDT, XRP, and SOL, covering every activity in the program without a deposit from you.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade on the Spot Orderbook
guide.description: Place buy and sell orders on the onchain orderbook. Spot volume feeds its own daily bucket and counts toward your leaderboard rank.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Open BNPL Positions
guide.description: Buy an asset through the BNPL flow, post collateral, and settle the balance over time. This is the feature Nowa most wants tested, and it draws from a different daily bucket than spot.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake into Vault and Earn
guide.description: Deposit NUSC into the Vault to finance other users’ BNPL positions, then stake into Earn for the second staking bucket. Both accrue NOWA continuously, so funds parked early keep working while you focus elsewhere.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Build Your Referral Tree
guide.description: Share your invite code from the dashboard. Referral activity has its own daily bucket on top of the 10%, 5%, and 2.5% commissions.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
